description: Automation Framework Task – Executive Brief   We’re looking for a sharp, solutions-driven engineer to design a scalable and   maintainable test automation project using modern best practices.   Your Task:   Build a test automation framework in TS using:   • Playwright WebDriver   Key Requirements:   • Cross-browser support: Chrome & Firefox.  • Parallel test execution   • Page Object Model (POM) for structure and maintainability   • Generate test execution reports (e.g., Allure or Extent Reports)  Task Overview:   UI Task Web Automation with Playwright   • Open the website: https://www.saucedemo.com/   • Implement all login scenarios on the web application (valid, invalid, locked out,   etc.).   • Implement a full product order scenario (add to cart, checkout, finish) for the logged-in  user. Add one product to the cart   • Support cross-browser testing (Chrome and Firefox).   • Implement parallel execution.   • Deliver clean, maintainable, and well-structured code.
